description: This file defines the class `ShortcutHelper`, which manages Android app shortcuts, including creating, refreshing, pinning, enabling/disabling, and fetching favicons for shortcuts.

classes.name: ShortcutHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage app shortcuts, including creation, refresh, pinning, enabling/disabling, and favicon fetching.

methods.name: ShortcutHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing ShortcutHelper with application context.

methods.name: maybeRestoreAllDynamicShortcuts
methods.description: Placeholder for restoring dynamic shortcuts if none exist.

methods.name: reportShortcutUsed
methods.description: Reports usage of a shortcut to the system.

methods.name: callShortcutManager
methods.description: Wrapper to handle calling ShortcutManager methods with error handling.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all shortcuts associated with the app, including manifest, dynamic, and pinned shortcuts.

methods.name: refreshShortcuts
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes shortcuts based on last refresh time, updating stale shortcuts.

methods.name: createShortcutForUrl
methods.description: Creates a ShortcutInfo object for a given URL.

methods.name: setSiteInformation
methods.description: Sets the label and icon of a shortcut based on the URL's favicon.

methods.name: setExtras
methods.description: Sets additional metadata (like last refresh time) on a shortcut.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Ensures URLs start with http:// or https://

methods.name: addWebSiteShortcut
methods.description: Adds a new website shortcut, either pinned or dynamic.

methods.name: requestPinShortcut
methods.description: Requests to pin a shortcut using the system.

methods.name: fetchFavicon
methods.description: Downloads favicon.ico from a URL to use as shortcut icon.
